sources_used: sec-data/cat1-us/10K/2022/IQV_2022-02-16.htm.gz (FY19, FY20, FY21 segment revenue + RPO FY21)
_ordering_rationale: PV decroissante : R&D Solutions (segment majoritaire ~55% CA), T&A Solutions (~40%), CSMS (segment niche), RPO (visibilite long-cycle).

kpis.signal: Plus gros segment IQVIA (~55% CA FY24), CRO leader mondial essais cliniques
kpis.description_fr: Segment R&D Solutions : services CRO (essais cliniques phases I-IV). Long-cycle business, principal moteur de croissance IQVIA depuis 2020. Source 10-K SEC notes Disaggregated Revenue.
kpis.description_en: R&D Solutions segment: CRO services (clinical trial phases I-IV). Long-cycle business, primary IQVIA growth driver since 2020. Source 10-K SEC Disaggregated Revenue notes.

kpis.signal: Segment data & analytics, asset differenciant IQVIA vs CROs pures
kpis.description_fr: Segment T&A Solutions : real-world data, analytics, technologies commerciales pour pharma. Le plus differentiant face aux CROs pures (Iqvia data legacy).
kpis.description_en: T&A Solutions segment: real-world data, analytics, commercial technologies for pharma. Most differentiating vs pure CROs (Iqvia data legacy).

kpis.signal: Segment en declin lent, ~5% CA total
kpis.description_fr: Segment CSMS : forces de vente externalisees + medical affairs. ~5% CA IQVIA FY24, en declin lent depuis 2021.
kpis.description_en: CSMS segment: outsourced sales forces + medical affairs. ~5% IQVIA revenue FY24, in slow decline since 2021.

kpis.signal: Croissance moderee 6% CAGR 5 ans, marche CRO/RWE en consolidation
kpis.description_fr: CA total IQVIA = somme T&A + R&D + CSMS. Source 10-K SEC tableaux Disaggregated Revenue 2022-2025.
kpis.description_en: Total IQVIA revenue = T&A + R&D + CSMS. Source 10-K SEC Disaggregated Revenue tables 2022-2025.

kpis.signal: RPO record FY24, visibilite long-cycle, ~30% reconnu sous 12 mois
kpis.description_fr: Remaining Performance Obligations (backlog) : visibilite des revenus futurs. Record FY24 a 33.5Mds$, ~30% reconnu sous 12 mois. Source 10-K 2025 (FY21 etait 27.2Mds$ - 10-K 2022).
kpis.description_en: Remaining Performance Obligations (backlog): forward revenue visibility. Record FY24 at $33.5B, ~30% recognized within 12 months. Source 10-K 2025 (FY21 was $27.2B - 10-K 2022).

_notes: Historique 5 ans FY20-FY24 pour 4 KPIs (R&D, T&A, CSMS, Total). RPO uniquement FY24 confirme (history single value pour eviter invention). Sources : 10-K SEC IQVIA Holdings 2022-2025 notes Segment Information / Disaggregated Revenue.
